# Long-tail format fixtures

- `chm_basic.chm` was compiled by `rustchm` 0.1.2 from the six entries in `chm_basic_sources/`. It exercises LZX-compressed files across multiple blocks, a 128 KiB incompressible file, an empty file and a CJK file name. `rustchm` is MIT-licensed; the generated fixture is checked in for repeatable reader and safety tests. [Source crate](https://crates.io/crates/rustchm/0.1.2).
- `longtail_iso9660.iso.gz` is a gzip-compressed ISO 9660/Joliet image generated with macOS `hdiutil makehybrid` from the text file `HELLO.TXT` containing `RustZIP ISO fixture`. The image is generated test data with no third-party payload.
- `longtail_lha_lh0.lzh` is libarchive's uncompressed LHA header-level 0 test fixture. It contains dummy text, directories, and relative symlinks. The fixture is BSD-2-Clause test data. [Source test](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_lha.c), [encoded fixture](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/test/test_read_format_lha_lh0.lzh.uu).
- `longtail_xar.xar` is a small XAR archive generated by bsdtar 3.7.4 from the text file `hello.txt` containing `RustZIP XAR fixture`. It is generated test data with no third-party payload.
- `longtail_rpm_bzip2.rpm` and `longtail_rpm_gzip.rpm` are libarchive's BSD-2-Clause RPM-filter fixtures, generated upstream from minimal packages containing three `hello` text files and bzip2 / gzip CPIO payloads. The fixtures are decoded from vendored upstream uuencoded test files. [bzip2 source test](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/libarchive/test/test_read_format_cpio_svr4_bzip2_rpm.c), [gzip source test](https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/blob/master/libarchive/libarchive/test/test_read_format_cpio_svr4_gzip_rpm.c).
# NSIS non-solid Deflate

`nsis_deflate.exe` was independently compiled using makensis 3.13 from
`nsis_sources/basic.nsi`, `payload.txt` and `empty.txt` in this repository.
Rebuild from `nsis_sources` with
`makensis -DOUTPUT_FILE=/absolute/path/nsis_deflate.exe basic.nsi`.
It contains a stored file, an empty file and a Unicode path, with NSIS CRC enabled.
The executable is parsed as archive data and must never be run by tests.

`wim_stored.wim` was independently generated with 7-Zip 26.05 using
`7zz a -twim wim_stored.wim . -mx=0` from a directory containing `empty.txt` and
`目录/中文.txt` (the latter has the same bytes as `nsis_sources/payload.txt`).
No 7-Zip source or binary is included in RustZIP.

`dmg_hfs_zlib.dmg` was generated on macOS using
`hdiutil create -srcfolder <same WIM fixture directory> -fs HFS+ -format UDZO -volname RustZIPFixture <output>`.
It has a GPT partition map, HFS+ catalog, zlib blocks, an empty file and a CJK path.
Tests parse the image without mounting it.

`wim_xpress.wim` was generated with wimlib-imagex 1.14.5 using
`capture <source> wim_xpress.wim RustZIPFixture --compress=XPRESS --no-acls`.
The source is the stored fixture tree plus `large.txt`, whose content is
`b"RustZIP compressed chunk fixture.\n" * 4096`. It exercises multiple 32 KiB chunks.

`nsis_lzma.exe`, `nsis_deflate_solid.exe` and `nsis_lzma_solid.exe` use the same
`basic.nsi`, with `-DCOMPRESSION=lzma` or `zlib`, `-DSOLID` for solid variants,
and `-DLARGE_SOURCE=<file>`. That file contains
`b"RustZIP LZMA streaming.\n" * 4096`; its embedded name is `compressed.txt`.

`wim_lzx.wim` was generated from the same `wim_xpress.wim` input using
`wimlib-imagex capture <source> wim_lzx.wim RustZIPFixture --compress=LZX --no-acls`.
`wim_lzms.wim` uses the same source with `--compress=LZMS`, and
`wim_lzms_solid.esd` uses `--solid --compress=LZMS`.
`nsis_bzip2.exe` and `nsis_bzip2_solid.exe` use the same source script and
large fixture input, with `-DCOMPRESSION=bzip2` and optional `-DSOLID`.
`dmg_apfs_zlib.dmg` was created on macOS with `hdiutil create -srcfolder
<source> -fs APFS -format UDZO -volname RustZIPFixture <output>`; it is parsed
as a file and is not mounted by tests.
# APFS 透明压缩样本

`apfs_compressed.bin` 来自 SecurityRonin/apfs-forensic 的
`tests/data/apfs_content.bin`（commit `a1951abc7adfe40ca087bba96f50c72963e028d9`）。
上游说明该 442 块 APFS 分区切片由 macOS hdiutil 和 ditto 创建，可再分发，
含 180000 字节的 decmpfs type 8 LZVN 资源分叉。上游记录 macOS 解压
SHA-256 为 `3f58a41850c1096de883ada14c98c2375a85b473c80ccbef03c9e72c113abc78`。
本项目测试扫描该真实文件系统并与已知原文逐字节比较；该切片不是完整 DMG。
`dmg_apfs_compressed.dmg` 是通过 `python3 fuzz/make_apfs_dmg_seed.py <输出路径>`
将该真实分区切片封装进合成 GPT / UDIF raw 容器得到，供端到端及 fuzz 使用；
文件系统与压缩数据均保持原样，GPT / UDIF 不来自 macOS。
